depends_on.name: child
depends_on.documentation: The finer/subordinate subject (a part, member, or derivative).

depends_on.name: parent
depends_on.documentation: The whole, group, or source subject.

depends_on.name: time_reference_#
depends_on.documentation: Optional: when an EVENT relation happened (e.g. `encountered`), as one or more time_reference anchors — so an event-relation can be the timestamped record. Empty for timeless relations (part_of, derived_from). (D10 multi-party binding.)

fields.name: relation
fields.documentation: The specific relationship as an enumerated ontology term (RO-backed). directed: part_of/contained_in/member_of (containment) or derived_from/aliquot_of/sample_of/passage_of (provenance). V_eta declares the corpus-exercised minimum (D6).
